# yyjson vendored source

This directory vendors the unmodified `yyjson.c`, `yyjson.h` and `LICENSE` from yyjson 0.13.0.
Upstream: https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson
Pinned tag: `0.13.0`
Tag commit: `138b4a7e757426bbbaa11ca37f257ce8d8489007`
License: MIT.

The files come from the upstream [0.13.0 release tag](https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson/tree/0.13.0).
Only the reader is used, and yyjson is linked into the wasm target only.
